Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-1, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-16.
R4C-moose-walk-0004.recDirections: At Morrissey on Hwy 3, turn off onto the Morrissey Road. This is the same road to Morrissey Provincial Park. Continue past the park and cross the Elk River. Turn right and follow Morrissey Road to the 17 km road marker. Continue straight ahead at the 17 km road marker crossing over Morrissey Creek. Here you will see the Lodgepole FSR sign. Continue straight ahead over a low pass to the 25 km road marker. The road forks here, take the left fork going up Lodgepole Creek. The Lodgepole FSR turns into the Flathead FSR @ Harvey Creek. Stay on the Flathead FSR, travelling south, passed the junction with the Ram Creek FSR. The Howell Creek Recreation Site is just passed the bridge crossing Howell Creek on the right.

tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.6 km and about 4 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
